title: Split Array Into Consecutive Subsequences
description:
Given a sorted nondecreasing array, determine whether its values can be partitioned into one or more subsequences that are consecutive increasing integers and each have length at least three. Return a Boolean result.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [1,2,3,3,4,5]
Output: true
```

```text
Input: nums = [1,2,3,4,4,5]
Output: false
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length <= 10^4`
- `-1000 <= nums[i] <= 1000`
- `nums` is sorted in nondecreasing order
